featureCells.description: Dependency defaults disabled; only snapback-engine/engine-owner is enabled; no test-support.
Unifies test-support across snapback-auth, snapback-engine, snapback-kernel, snapback-sync, and snapback-types.
Enables exactly snapback-services/remainder-tests with dependency defaults disabled.
